correctness.rationale: Holomorphic monomials form a complete orthogonal basis; T_f matrix entries equal positive-normalization times all mixed moments ∫f w^γ bar(w)^δ dμ. Polarized real-analytic expansion of Q_f(z)=K(z,z) Bf(z) recovers those moments, establishing common kernel. For m≥1, |f|dμ has some positive exponential moment; its directional Fourier transform is analytic in a strip with all derivatives zero, forcing f=0. For 0<m<1, β=αtan(πm/2), exact complex Gamma integral phase (2d+n)π/2 annihilates sin moments for even n and cos for odd; antipodal even/odd angular decomposition cancels every mixed moment, not just radial ones. Norm bounds ||Ja||∞≥(1/2)||a||∞ and ≤2||a||∞ give closed L∞(sphere) embedding. Positive 1±εsin(βr^m) symbols have identical Toeplitz I and Berezin 1. Independent parity calculations corroborated exact phase, not infinity proof.
